pages.title: A Little Direction
pages.text: Right-click Nature’s Compass in the air once.

pages.title: A Little Direction
pages.text: Choose a destination before walking into the unknown.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Craft the compass using its recipe, choose a biome in its menu, then follow its bearing. The task counts the right-click, not arrival.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Open the full map with its configured key, drag to pan and scroll to zoom. Choose surface/cave layers for the correct dimension. Personal waypoints, bases and deaths remain private; explored terrain and authoritative boss discoveries are shared. Teleport depends on server permission, not a client

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: command setting. Nature's Compass locates the chosen biome; Shift+Use resets it.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Manage private waypoints with native map controls; dimensions and waypoint sets remain separate. If a map appears reset, check world/subworld selection. Minimap, radar, cave layers, grid, light and slime overlays have separate settings; server profiles/item gates take priority. The full map can

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: export PNG. Resource-pack textures and third-party overlays are not proof of boss discovery.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Open Options → Controls → Key Binds and search for part of an action name to find the binding for an unfamiliar tool or interface.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: In Key Binds, use the conflicts filter to find actions sharing a key. Inspect available keys and rebind the intended action to an unused one.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Return to your grave and break it to recover its stored items. Sneak recovery is another option when enabled by the server. Owner access and restoration to original slots depend on server settings; recovering items does not undo elimination from an event.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Read the obituary, when supplied, or right-click the grave to inspect the owner, dimension, coordinates and stored-item information. Obituary creation is configurable; reading a record does not itself recover the items.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use an available grave recipe or Silk Touch to obtain a decorative grave, then rename it at an anvil to change its displayed text. Decoration does not restore another player’s possessions.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Obstructions or the void can move a grave away from the death point; failed placement can leave ordinary item drops. If a grave is missing, give the administrator its dimension, coordinates and recorded death ID. Administrative recovery uses the native record and restore flow; replace mode can

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: overwrite inventory and is not an ordinary survival action.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Look at a block/entity for contextual information. Controls lists overlay, fluid targeting, target recipes and uses; server storage values need server support. The spyglass has quick access and scroll zoom.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click Nature’s Compass, select a biome in its menu and start the search. If it finds a target, follow its bearing and distance. Search limits are configurable; no result does not prove the biome is absent from the world.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Sneak-use Nature’s Compass to reset its search. When it is not tracking a biome, it points toward world spawn.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use /tpa <player> to request visiting them or /tpahere <player> to invite them. The recipient uses /tpaccept; /tpacancel cancels and /tpatoggle blocks incoming requests. /back uses only permitted history. Active combat restrictions still apply.
